stemMarkdown: A shop offers two successive discounts of 12% and 18% on an item. What single discount percentage is equivalent to these two? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Take MP $= 100$. After 12%: $88$. After a further 18%: $72.16$. The total discount is $100 - 72.16 = 27.84\%$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equivalent discount $= d_1 + d_2 - \dfrac{d_1 d_2}{100} = 12 + 18 - \dfrac{216}{100} = 27.84\%$. Note it is **not** $30\%$.
